productBoundary.signaturePolicy: Never infer, generate, apply, or simulate a taxpayer signature.
productBoundary.certificationPolicy: Never claim CRA approval or certification.

versionPolicy.packageSelectionBasis: Province or territory of residence on 2025-12-31, subject to CRA special-situation rules.

t1Stages.name: Federal tax and non-refundable tax credits
Refund or balance owing and certification

resultLines.name: Tax paid by instalments
resultLines.rule: Use total valid 2025 instalment payments, including valid payments absent from INNS1 or INNS2 records.

resultLines.name: Refund
resultLines.calculation: absolute_value(43500 - 48200) when the result is negative
resultLines.smallDifferenceRule: CRA generally does not issue a refund of $2 or less.

resultLines.name: Balance owing
resultLines.smallDifferenceRule: CRA generally does not charge a difference of $2 or less.

schedules.name: Federal Amounts Transferred from your Spouse or Common-Law Partner
schedules.jurisdictionBoundary: Generic form excludes Quebec and non-residents.
schedules.trigger: Claiming unused eligible spouse or common-law partner amounts.
schedules.eligibilityBoundary: Not available after a qualifying separation of 90 days or more that includes December 31.

schedules.name: Capital Gains (or Losses)
schedules.trigger: Capital disposition, gain or loss, principal-residence designation, or potentially flipped property.
schedules.calculationBoundary: Positive taxable result transfers to 12700; a net capital loss does not transfer there and may support T1A.

schedules.name: Amounts for Spouse or Common-Law Partner and Dependants
schedules.trigger: Spouse, eligible dependant, caregiver, or infirm-child claims.

schedules.name: Canada Workers Benefit
schedules.jurisdictionBoundary: Generic form excludes Quebec, Alberta, and Nunavut.
schedules.trigger: Potential Canada workers benefit or advanced Canada workers benefit reconciliation.
schedules.eligibilityBoundary: Residence, working-income, age and family conditions apply; specified student, imprisonment, and diplomatic-status exclusions apply.

schedules.name: RRSP, PRPP, and SPP Contributions and Transfers, and HBP and LLP Activities
schedules.trigger: RRSP, PRPP, or SPP contributions, transfers, carryforward, HBP/LLP withdrawals or repayments, or employer PRPP interaction.

schedules.name: Canada Pension Plan Contributions and Overpayment
schedules.jurisdictionBoundary: For a non-Quebec resident with no Quebec earnings; use RC381 when CPP/QPP interaction applies.
schedules.trigger: CPP contribution, deduction, payable, or overpayment calculation.

schedules.name: Donations and Gifts
schedules.trigger: Current gifts or unused gifts from the applicable carryforward period.
schedules.eligibilityBoundary: General unused gifts use five prior years; ecological gifts may use ten prior years.

schedules.name: Employment Insurance and Provincial Parental Insurance Plan Premiums
schedules.jurisdictionBoundary: Quebec and specified non-resident situations only.

schedules.name: Federal Tuition, Education, and Textbook Amounts and Canada Training Credit
schedules.jurisdictionBoundary: Generic form excludes Quebec and non-residents.
schedules.trigger: Tuition, Canada training credit, transfer, or carryforward.

schedules.name: Multigenerational Home Renovation Tax Credit
schedules.trigger: Eligible renovation creating a qualifying secondary unit.
schedules.eligibilityBoundary: Residence, qualifying-individual, qualifying-relation, dwelling, and expenditure rules apply.

schedules.name: Employment Insurance Premiums on Self-Employment and Other Eligible Earnings
schedules.trigger: Existing agreement with the Canada Employment Insurance Commission for self-employed special benefits.

schedules.name: FHSA Contributions, Transfers and Activities
schedules.trigger: FHSA opening or successor status, contributions, transfers, deduction, withdrawal, or taxable activity.
schedules.eligibilityBoundary: Opening a first FHSA in 2025 may require the schedule even without transactions.

not listed in the current 2025 resident package
absentCurrentSchedules.replacement: Current T1 lines and 5000-D1 Federal Worksheet as applicable

conditionalForms.name: Joint Election to Split Pension Income
conditionalForms.trigger: Joint election to split eligible pension income.
conditionalForms.signatureRequirement: Both spouses or common-law partners complete and sign identical forms.

conditionalForms.name: Statement of Business or Professional Activities
conditionalForms.trigger: Business, professional, or self-employed commission activity; use a separate form for each activity.

conditionalForms.name: Moving Expenses Deduction
conditionalForms.uncertainty: Current instructions clearly require retaining supporting records but are not sufficiently explicit here about attaching the completed T1-M.

conditionalForms.name: Statement of Resource Expenses and Depletion Allowance
Request for Loss Carryback
conditionalForms.trigger: Eligible current-year loss and election to carry it back.
conditionalForms.eligibilityBoundary: Do not infer eligibility from a negative T1 line alone.

conditionalForms.name: Statement of Deferred Security Options Benefits
Capital Gains Deduction for Qualifying Business Transfers
Disability Tax Credit Certificate
conditionalForms.eligibilityBoundary: Do not infer current approval from a prior-year value.

conditionalForms.name: Inter-provincial Calculation for CPP and QPP Contributions and Overpayments
conditionalForms.jurisdictionBoundary: Use instead of generic Schedule 8 where CPP/QPP interaction requires it.

conditionalForms.name: Provincial and Territorial Taxes for Multiple Jurisdictions
conditionalForms.jurisdictionBoundary: Replaces the ordinary single-province Form 428 in applicable multiple-jurisdiction cases.

conditionalForms.name: Employee and Partner GST/HST Rebate Application
Return of Fuel Charge Proceeds to Farmers Tax Credit
Foreign Income Verification Statement
conditionalForms.trigger: Specified foreign property cost exceeded CAN$100,000 at any time in the year.
conditionalForms.deadlineRule: Same filing deadline as the individual's income tax return.
conditionalForms.reportingBoundary: Part A is available only when total cost was more than CAN$100,000 but less than CAN$250,000 throughout the year; otherwise Part B applies.

conditionalForms.name: Reconciliation of 2025 Business Income for Tax Purposes
Information About Your Residency Status
conditionalForms.trigger: Factual-resident or other special residence situation identified by the current package instructions.

conditionalForms.name: Provincial or Territorial Foreign Tax Credit
conditionalForms.trigger: Applicable provincial or territorial foreign tax credit outside Quebec.

conditionalForms.name: Tax shelter information and loss or deduction statement
conditionalForms.trigger: Tax shelter slip, loss, or deduction applies.

conditionalForms.name: Statement of Qualifying Retroactive Lump-Sum Payment
conditionalForms.trigger: Payer issued the statement for a qualifying retroactive lump-sum payment.
conditionalForms.eligibilityBoundary: Do not infer qualification or the alternative CRA calculation from the payment amount alone.

conditionalForms.name: Individual Tax Return for RRSP, PRPP and SPP Excess Contributions
conditionalForms.eligibilityBoundary: These are separate returns, not ordinary T1 schedules; do not hide their filing or payment obligation inside the annual T1 package.

conditionalForms.name: Income Exempt from Tax under the Indian Act
conditionalForms.trigger: Indian Act-exempt income indicator is selected.

conditionalForms.name: Principal residence designation
conditionalForms.trigger: Disposition designated as a principal residence by an individual or a deceased person's representative.

spousePartnerFields: net income from line 23600 or amount that would be reported, including zero

generalAttach: one copy of each applicable information slip
completed forms and schedules when instructed
T776 or an equivalent rental-income statement

attach: copy of final pay statement or other statement
action being taken to obtain the slip

retain: supporting documents not specifically required with the return

residentAreas: Quebec: all areas other than Montreal, Outaouais, or Sherbrooke

selfEmployedIndividualOrSpouse.exception: The extended filing date does not apply where business expenditures relate mainly to a tax-shelter investment.

deadlines.weekendHolidayRule: Return is timely when received or postmarked by the next business day; payment is timely when received by the next business day.

instalments.farmerFisherException: Qualifying farmers and fishers generally have one December 31 due date.

refundAndPayment.interest: Daily compound interest begins after the balance-due date on outstanding amounts.

certificationAndSignature.certificationMeaning: The filer certifies that the return and attached documents are correct, complete, and fully disclose income.
certificationAndSignature.nativeEfileFieldTreatment: Preserve as part of the official form but never expose as an application filing capability.

postMail.adjustmentRoute: Wait for the notice of assessment, then use the applicable adjustment route, including T1-ADJ by mail where appropriate.

uncertainties: The inventory does not determine an individual's eligibility.
Complete provincial and territorial calculations remain outside this federal slice.
Exact current revisions for every conditional non-schedule form were not individually verified.
T1-M paper attachment status requires claim-specific manual confirmation.
Donation and foreign-tax-credit attachment requirements vary by claim type.
Ontario and Quebec mailing-area boundaries are not published as a complete postal-code mapping.
Acceptance of automatically embedded signatures on mailed T1 returns was not established.
The explicit application acknowledgement is a product control, not a CRA-prescribed software workflow.
IC97-2 creates format and approval boundaries for customized or software-generated returns.
CRA may require situation-specific forms not enumerated here; unknown conditions must fail closed to manual review.
